```plato

    //==
    // # Welding
    //
    // Turning triangle soup into a mesh with shared vertices: the pass marching
    // cubes, CSG and STL import all want and nothing in the tree provided.
    // Two vertices merge when they are within `tolerance` of each other; the
    // survivor is the lowest-numbered member of the group and keeps its own
    // position, so welding never moves geometry.
    //
    // Cost: quadratic in the vertex count.

    // The lowest-numbered vertex within `tolerance` of vertex i. Scans downwards
    // so the last match kept is the smallest, the same trick
    // `FirstCornerOfVertex` (`meshes-polygon.library.plato`) uses.
    WeldRepresentative(positions: Array<Point3D>, i: Integer, tolerance: Number): VertexIndex
        => VertexIndex((i + 1).MapRange(j => i - j)
            .Reduce(i, (found, j) => positions[j].Distance(positions[i]) <= tolerance ? j : found));
```
